request_outcomes.question: Which insurers do you accept?
request_outcomes.answer:
We accept most major insurance providers, including Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, and Medicare (Original Medicare Part B) for medical visits. If you're unsure whether your specific plan is covered, you can ask me to connect you with a member of our friendly front desk team.

For dental care, medical insurance does not cover dental services. We accept these dental plans: Delta Dental PPO, MetLife PDP Plus, and Guardian DentalGuard Preferred. We do not accept dental HMO (DHMO) plans, including Cigna Dental Care DHMO. If you don't hold one of these accepted dental plans, dental appointments are self-pay, including for Medicare patients whose Medicare does not cover routine dental care.

We do not currently accept Medicaid or Medicaid managed care plans.

Answer: We accept most major insurance providers, including Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, and Medicare. If you're unsure whether your specific plan is covered, you can ask me to connect you with a member of our friendly front desk team. They'll be happy to help clarify your coverage.

# Dental care guide
## Dental insurance

Medical insurance plans do not cover dental care. For dental appointments we accept these dental plans: Delta Dental PPO, MetLife PDP Plus and Guardian DentalGuard Preferred. We do not accept dental HMO (DHMO) plans, including Cigna Dental Care DHMO. If you do not hold one of the accepted dental plans, dental appointments are self-pay.

# Insurance plan guide
## Medicare and Medicaid

We accept Original Medicare (Part B) for medical visits. Medicare does not cover routine dental care, so dental appointments are self-pay for Medicare patients unless they also hold one of the dental plans listed in our dental care guide. We do not currently accept Medicaid or Medicaid managed care plans.

patient_message.content: Which insurers do you accept, and which practitioners do you have?

assistant_message.content:
We accept most major insurance providers for medical visits, including Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, and Medicare (Original Medicare Part B). If you're unsure whether your specific plan is covered, just let me know and I can connect you with our front desk team.

For dental care, medical insurance doesn't apply - dental services are covered separately. We accept Delta Dental PPO, MetLife PDP Plus, and Guardian DentalGuard Preferred, but we do not accept dental HMO (DHMO) plans, including Cigna Dental Care DHMO. Please note we do not currently accept Medicaid or Medicaid managed care plans.

As for appointments, we currently have two practitioners available: Dr. William Osler for General Practice (60-minute appointments) and Dr. Andreas Vesalius for Dentistry (60-minute appointments). Both are currently accepting new appointments - let me know if you'd like to book with either of them.

# Insurance plan guide
## Aetna

We are in-network with Aetna Choice POS II and Aetna Open Access Managed Choice. Aetna Medicare Advantage PPO plans are in-network as well. Plans administered by Aetna Signature Administrators use a separate network, and we are not part of it.

# Insurance plan guide
## Cigna

We are in-network with Cigna Open Access Plus (OAP) and Cigna PPO plans. Cigna LocalPlus plans are in-network only for members who live in our county; the network area is printed on the back of the card. Cigna Connect plans bought through the health insurance marketplace are not in-network.

# Insurance plan guide
## UnitedHealthcare

We are in-network with UnitedHealthcare Choice Plus and UnitedHealthcare Options PPO. UnitedHealthcare Navigate HMO is not in-network. AARP Medicare Advantage plans from UnitedHealthcare are in-network when the plan is a PPO, and not in-network when it is an HMO.

# Insurance plan guide

This guide lists, plan by plan, the health insurance plans we are in-network with. Insurance companies sell many plans under one brand name, and being in-network with a company does not mean being in-network with every plan it sells. Check the plan name printed on the front of your insurance card - it usually appears next to the company logo or under "Plan" - and compare it with the lists below.
